dataset.name: deepset/prompt-injections
dataset.licence: apache-2.0 (card front matter also lists cc-by-4.0 under dataset_info)
dataset.notes: English and German. Labels follow deepset's broad definition: any attempt to steer the model off task (for example 'act as an interviewer') counts as an injection.

dataset.name: Lakera/gandalf_ignore_instructions
dataset.notes: Prompts submitted to the Gandalf game, selected by embedding similarity to 'Ignore all previous instructions' (similarity >= 0.825). All injections; the publisher notes a little label noise.

dataset.name: jackhhao/jailbreak-classification
dataset.notes: Jailbreak prompts (DAN-style persona prompts) against benign prompts, many of them benign role-play ('You are a fast-talking merchant...'). A jailbreak is not always an injection; reported on its own.

dataset.name: databricks/databricks-dolly-15k
dataset.notes: Instructions written by Databricks employees (brainstorming, QA, summarisation, classification), with their reference context when present. All benign. Share-alike licence: downloaded, never redistributed.
